Counting Finite Topologies by Transfer Matrix

Cleo Duarte
Institute of Combinatorics

Abstract

We describe a transfer matrix method for counting topologies on a finite
set and extend the known sequence by two terms.

1. Introduction

The number of distinct topologies on an n-element set grows very quickly.
Kleitman and Rothschild gave asymptotics; exact values are known only for
small n.

2. The transfer matrix

We build the matrix layer by layer.

2.1 Construction

Each antichain contributes one row.

2.2 Complexity

The method is exponential but tractable to n = 18.

3. Results

The two new terms agree with independent direct search.

4. Discussion and Conclusions

Transfer matrices are currently the most effective exact method.
